name: Fire OG
summary: Fire OG is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred in California in the 2000s by [[breeder:OG Raskal Genetics]], a cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[sfv-og|SFV OG]]. The name refers to the red pistils on its flowers.

sources.title: Fire OG strain: all you need to know
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms OG Raskal Genetics as breeder, the OG Kush x SFV OG cross, and the 2000s date.

sources.title: Fire OG
